title: `ingress-per-unit` requirer schema
description: The `ingress-per-unit` root schema comprises the entire requirer databag for this interface.

name.title: Application Name
name.description: The name of the unit requesting ingress.

model.title: Model Name
model.description: The name of the model the unit requesting ingress is in.

host.title: Hostname
host.description: Hostname the unit wishes to be exposed.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port the unit wishes to be exposed.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether the unit wishes to be exposed over HTTP or TCP.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The scheme to use in the URL at which ingress is provided.

strip-prefix.title: Strip Prefix
strip-prefix.description: Whether to strip the prefix from the ingress URL before forwarding requests to the unit. Only set when true.

redirect-https.title: Redirect HTTPS
redirect-https.description: Whether to redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS. Only set when true.
